명령 한 줄, 서버 안에서는 무슨 일이?: One command line: what happens inside the server?
노트북 터미널에서 <code>ssh oracle@dbserver01</c: From a laptop terminal you log in to the DB server with ssh oracle@dbserver01 and type sqlplus / as sysdba. It is one line on screen, but inside the server many things happen in turn.
누가 들어왔는지 확인하고, 셸이 명령을 찾고, 권한을 따지고, 프로세스를: It checks who came in, the shell finds the command, permissions are weighed, a process is created, memory is handed out, and data is written to disk. We follow this path one scene at a time. Every setting changed when preparing to install Oracle lies on this path.
오라클도 리눅스 위에서 돌아가는 프로그램 묶음입니다. 리눅스가 계정, 프: Oracle, too, is a bundle of programs running on Linux. If you know how Linux handles accounts, processes, memory, and files, you can see the cause of half of all Oracle incidents.
모든 파일은 / 하나에서 갈라진다: Every file branches from a single /
리눅스에는 C:, D: 같은 드라이브 문자가 없습니다. 모든 파일은 <s: Linux has no drive letters like C: or D:. Every file is in one tree that branches from / (root), and a disk is used by attaching it to a directory in this tree (mounting).
hier(7) 매뉴얼에 따르면 <code>/etc</code>는 이 컴퓨: According to the hier(7) manual, /etc holds this machine's configuration files, /home user homes, /tmp temporary files, /dev device files, and /proc is where the proc file system shows kernel and process information.
오라클은 설치 가이드의 <span class=\"term\">OFA</s: Oracle is placed under /u01/app/oracle (ORACLE_BASE) following the OFA rules of the installation guide. The Oracle home holding the programs is /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1.
<code>/proc</code> 아래 파일은 디스크에 없습니다. <co: Files under /proc are not on disk. When you run cat /proc/meminfo, the kernel turns the memory values of that moment into text and shows them.
리눅스는 이름이 아니라 번호로 사람을 안다: Linux knows people by number, not by name
로그인하면 리눅스는 <code>/etc/passwd</code>에서 내: When you log in, Linux finds your line in /etc/passwd. According to passwd(5), a line has 7 colon-separated fields: name:password:UID:GID:comment:home:shell. The x in the password field means the real value is in /etc/shadow.
oracle 계정은 <span class=\"term\">UID</spa: The oracle account has UID 54321, its primary group is oinstall (54321), and it belongs to secondary groups such as dba (54322). These are the numbers the preinstall RPM creates, and every program run from this shell inherits them.
<code>sqlplus / as sysdba</code>가 비밀번호 없: sqlplus / as sysdba works without a password because this OS account belongs to the dba group (OSDBA). A single group decides the highest DB privilege, so managing groups is security itself.
셸은 PATH를 따라 명령을 찾는다: The shell finds commands by following PATH
로그인 셸 bash는 시작할 때 홈의 <code>~/.bash_profi: The login shell bash reads ~/.bash_profile in the home directory when it starts and sets up environment variables. The installation guide also names this file as bash's startup file. On a server where installation is finished, ORACLE_HOME, ORACLE_SID, and PATH are usually written here.
<code>sqlplus</code>처럼 경로 없이 친 명령은 <span: A command typed without a path, like sqlplus, is looked up in the directories listed in PATH, one by one from the front. According to the Bash manual, if it is not found by the end, bash prints an error and returns exit code 127. This is command not found.
<code>.bash_profile</code>을 고쳐도 이미 열린 셸에: Editing .bash_profile does not affect shells that are already open. You must log in again or read it in with . ~/.bash_profile.
-- PATH에 없을 때: bash: sqlplus: command no: -- When it is not in PATH: bash: sqlplus: command not found
찾았다면, 실행해도 되는가: Found it, but may it be run?
파일마다 <span class=\"term\">소유자</span>, <s: Every file has r (read), w (write), and x (execute) permissions for its owner, its group, and other users. The kernel compares the UID and groups of the person trying to run it with the file and looks only at the permissions of the matching set.
실행 권한이 없으면 <code>Permission denied</code: Without execute permission you get Permission denied. The default permissions of a new file are set by the umask. As in the umask(2) example, with 022 the two write bits are removed from 0666, giving 0644 (rw-r--r--). The installation guide says to set the oracle account's umask to 022.
오라클 설치 디렉터리는 <code>oracle:oinstall</code: Oracle installation directories are created owned by oracle:oinstall with mode 775. If they are left owned by root, the installer cannot create the Oracle home.
UID·그룹을 파일과 비교: Compare UID and groups with the file
$ chmod u+x ~/scripts/check_db.sh -- 소: $ chmod u+x ~/scripts/check_db.sh   -- execute permission for the owner
셸이 자기를 복제해 새 프로그램을 띄운다: The shell clones itself to start a new program
셸은 <code>fork()</code>로 자기와 똑같은 자식 <span: The shell creates a child process identical to itself with fork(), and the child replaces the program inside it with sqlplus using execve(). According to execve(2), the PID stays the same. The child inherits the UID and environment variables of the parent shell.
오라클 인스턴스도 프로세스 묶음입니다. <code>ps -ef</code: An Oracle instance is also a bundle of processes. In ps -ef they appear in the form ora_name_SID, such as ora_pmon_ORCL and ora_lgwr_ORCL. When you connect with sqlplus / as sysdba, one more server process is created to handle this session.
DB가 떠 있는지 가장 빨리 아는 방법이 <code>ps -ef | gr: This is why the fastest way to tell whether the DB is up is ps -ef | grep pmon. An instance is, in the end, Linux processes. If you kill them carelessly, the DB goes down.
30117 -- 지금 셸의 PID. sqlplus는 이 셸의 자식: 30117   -- PID of the current shell. sqlplus is a child of this shell
SGA는 여러 프로세스가 함께 쓰는 공유 메모리: The SGA is shared memory used by many processes together
프로세스마다 자기만 쓰는 메모리가 있습니다. 오라클의 PGA가 그렇습니다: Each process has memory that only it uses. Oracle's PGA is like that. But the SGA, such as the Buffer Cache, must be seen by dozens of Oracle processes together, so it is placed in Linux shared memory. shmget(2) is the system call that creates such System V shared memory segments.
<code>free</code>와 <code>/proc/meminfo</: Use free and /proc/meminfo to see RAM and swap. Swap is the place on disk where things are pushed out when RAM runs short. The installation guide's rule: with 2 to 16 GB of RAM, swap equal to RAM; with more than 16 GB, 16 GB.
dbserver01은 MemTotal 16108544 kB(약 15.4G: dbserver01 has MemTotal 16108544 kB (about 15.4 GB) and SwapTotal 8388604 kB (8 GB). By the rule, swap should be about 15.4 GB, so it falls short. You calculate this yourself in Linux Lab stage 1, lesson 7.
커널 파라미터와 limits: 두 겹의 상한선: Kernel parameters and limits: two layers of ceilings
공유 메모리 조각의 최대 크기(<code>kernel.shmmax</co: Values such as the maximum size of a shared memory segment (kernel.shmmax), the total amount of shared memory (shmall), semaphores (kernel.sem), and the system-wide number of open files (fs.file-max) are kernel parameters that apply to the whole server. You write them in a file in /etc/sysctl.d/ and apply them with sysctl --system.
그 아래에 사용자별 상한선 <span class=\"term\">limi: Below that are per-user ceilings, the limits. They are written in /etc/security/limits.conf and limits.d, and take effect only after logging in again. The installation guide's values are open files soft 1024 and hard 65536, processes soft 2047 and hard 16384, and stack soft at least 10240 KB.
세마포어 최소값은 <code>250 32000 100 128</code>: The semaphore minimum is 250 32000 100 128, and file-max is 6815744. A single preinstall RPM puts in these values and the oracle account's limits all at once. This is also the place most often gotten wrong on servers prepared by hand.
~ 다시 로그인해야 limits 적용: ~ limits apply only after logging in again
큰 SGA는 큰 페이지에 올린다: A large SGA goes on large pages
리눅스는 메모리를 보통 4KB <span class=\"term\">페이: Linux usually manages memory in 4 KB pages. With an 8 GB SGA that is over 2 million pages, and every process needs page tables pointing to them. HugePages is a feature that reserves large pages in advance, such as 2 MB on x86.
필요한 수는 SGA ÷ 페이지 크기입니다. 8GB = 8192MB ÷ 2: The number needed is SGA ÷ page size. 8 GB = 8192 MB ÷ 2 MB = 4096, which goes in vm.nr_hugepages. According to the kernel documentation, HugePages are not swapped out even when memory runs short.
Oracle 문서: 자동 메모리 관리(AMM, <code>MEMORY_T: Oracle documentation: Automatic Memory Management (AMM, MEMORY_TARGET) cannot be used together with HugePages. THP (Transparent HugePages) is also handled differently by kernel: disable it before UEK7, and leave it at madvise on UEK7 and later.
물리 <span class=\"term\">디스크</span>(sdb)는: A physical disk (sdb) cannot hold files as it is. You divide it with partitions or LVM, create a file system on top, and mount it on a directory in the tree (/u01) before you can write files.
<code>df -h</code>는 파일 시스템별 크기와 사용률을, <c: df -h shows the size and usage of each file system, and du shows how much a directory takes up. Each disk also has an I/O scheduler. The installation guide's rule on Linux 8 and later is mq-deadline for HDDs and none for SSDs and NVMe.
오라클이 디스크에 쓰는 것은 데이터 파일만이 아닙니다. alert log: Oracle writes more than data files to disk. The alert log, trace files, archived logs, backups, and dumps all pile up on this file system too.
밤사이 덤프 파일이 쌓여 <code>/u01</code>이 100%가 됐: Dump files piled up overnight and /u01 reached 100%. When there is no free space, Linux refuses writes (No space left on device). Oracle can no longer write the alert log, trace files, or archived logs.
아카이브 로그를 보관하지 못하면 오라클은 <code>ORA-00257:: If it cannot archive logs, Oracle raises ORA-00257: Archiver error. Connect AS SYSDBA only until resolved., and if that is not cleared, transactions stop. The response is to find where it is full with df -h, find what is large with du, and delete only what is safe to delete.
급하다고 <code>rm</code>으로 아카이브 로그나 데이터 파일을: Even in a hurry, do not delete archived logs or data files with rm. Archived logs must be cleaned up with RMAN so they match RMAN's records. What is safe to delete is decided by the handover notes and the retention policy.

정리: 오라클이 기대는 리눅스 다섯 기둥: Summary: the five pillars of Linux that Oracle relies on
계정과 그룹이 누가 무엇을 할지 정하고, 셸과 환경 변수가 명령을 찾게: Accounts and groups decide who may do what, and the shell and environment variables let commands be found.
프로그램은 프로세스로 돌고, SGA는 공유 메모리에 올라갑니다. 커널 파: Programs run as processes, and the SGA lives in shared memory. Kernel parameters and limits are their ceilings.
모든 파일은 / 트리에 마운트된 파일 시스템 위에 있고, 가득 차면 오라: Every file lives on a file system mounted into the / tree, and when it fills up, Oracle stops too.
